aufinitygroupgmbh-aufinity-group-gmbh:as.title: (Senior) European Partnership Manager (m/f/d)
aufinitygroupgmbh-aufinity-group-gmbh:as.description: Your mission Are you looking for real impact in the European automotive industry? At Aufinity, you will lead strategic partnership management at eye level with top DMS and IT players, shape our network of 60+ integration partners, and secure our market position for the future. Become a key player for sustainable collaborations and outstanding system integration at one of Germany’s leading fintech success stories. - True partnerships: Build and expand sustainable relationships with leading DMS and IT providers in the automotive industry - Strong market position: Through targeted initiatives, you secure and expand collaboration with major industry players - Unique industry vision: Represent our mission of “Autonomous Finance” convincingly and win new partners for the integration of our solutions - New cooperation opportunities: Identify new opportunities early, conclude value-generating agreements, and actively shape our partner network - High-level teamwork: Realize successful integration projects and go-to-market strategies in collaboration with Product, Sales, Marketing, and Tech Your profile - Business drive: Minimum 5 years of experience in business development, partner management, or strategic sales, preferably in automotive or IT - Academic background: Degree in business, IT, engineering, or a comparable qualification - Industry know-how: Deep understanding of the European automotive landscape, especially dealer management systems (DMS) - Partnership expertise: Strong record in building and developing strategic B2B technology partnerships - Communication skills: Outstanding presence, networking, and negotiation abilities on the international stage - International mindset: Fluent in English (other European languages like IT/ES/FR a plus) Why us? - Excellence & Ownership: Full responsibility for your topics with a focus on quality, impact, and sustainable results - Purpose & creative freedom: Contribute your ideas, shape your area of responsibility, and co-create our company’s future and long-term success - Openness & respect: We foster open communication, direct exchange, and collaboration at eye level - Continuous growth: From trainings and cross-team learning to mentoring, you’ll always keep moving professionally and personally - Flexibility & team spirit: Enjoy benefits that make a difference—options for workation, team/company events, and allowances for lunch, internet, and commuting help you focus on what matters - Equal opportunities: Not just a buzzword for us—we welcome applicants of all backgrounds, identities, sexual orientations, and disabilities. Candidates with disabilities will be given preferential consideration if equally qualified About us We, Aufinity, are a Cologne-based FinTech Scaleup and pioneer for digital payment solutions in the automotive sector. In 2018, we launched bezahl.de, the first all-in-one platform for digital payment management in the automotive trade. With our product, we optimize internal payment processes and help our customers save valuable time and costs in the back office. At the same time, we enable car dealership groups to offer a fully digital payment process with various payment methods - including specialized payment methods for large sums - for the first time.

axiomtalentplatform-axiomtalentplatform:.description: Join Our Team as a Lawyer at Axiom! We are currently seeking Procurement Attorneys to work with some of the world’s largest technology, consumer goods, and professional services companies. Responsibilities: Draft, negotiate, and advise on procurement, sourcing, supplier, and vendor agreements, including agreements for raw materials, components, finished goods, and related services. Partner with procurement, supply chain, operations, and business teams on strategic sourcing initiatives, supplier relationships, and commercial negotiations. Advise on supplier risk and contract issues, including pricing, warranties, indemnification, product quality, shortages, delivery obligations, and business continuity. Provide legal guidance on procurement policies, compliance requirements, disputes, and supplier performance issues throughout the contracting lifecycle. Qualifications: 4+ years of experience as an attorney handling procurement, strategic sourcing, supply chain, and/or commercial contracting matters Experience drafting and negotiating complex supplier and procurement agreements, preferably involving raw materials, components, finished goods, or manufacturing Active attorney license in good standing with a U.S. state bar Compensation: The estimated total compensation for full-time Axiom attorney roles is $104,500-325,000 per year and for non-attorney roles is $71,250-309,750 per year. Compensation decisions are based on various factors, including, but not limited to, experience, skills, certifications, location, and business needs. Employees may be eligible for additional benefits, including health, dental, and vision insurance; paid holidays and PTO; flexible work arrangements; and professional development opportunities and tools. cimgroup-cimgroup:lever:cc63fc14-0441-4a.title: Maintenance Technician (Residential)
cimgroup-cimgroup:lever:cc63fc14-0441-4a.description: ABOUT CIM GROUP: CIM is a community-focused real estate and infrastructure owner, operator, lender, and developer. Our team of experts works together to identify and create value in real assets, benefiting the communities in which we invest. Back in 1994, our three founders focused on projects in Southern California neighborhoods. Today, we are a diverse team of 900+ employees with projects across the Americas. Our projects have delivered jobs; created comfortable places to live, work, and relax; and provided necessary and sustainable infrastructure. Our focus on enhancing communities is unwavering, and we strive to make an even greater impact in the years to come. Join us and make an impact today! POSITION PURPOSE The Residential Maintenance Technician reports to the Property Manager under the supervision of the Maintenance Supervisor and performs general maintenance and repair to ensure apartment units and other property facilities are maintained per CIM Group operating and safety standards. Responsibilities include diagnosing, troubleshooting, and repairing heating, ventilation and air conditioning (HVAC) units; electrical appliances, outlets, and light fixtures; plumbing, carpentry, and locks. Additional responsibilities include, but are not limited to, assisting with preparing vacant apartment units for rental and following a planned preventative maintenance schedule. Please note this is a talent pool posting; it will remain open to applications on an ongoing basis. We are always looking for talented individuals for this role as positions become available. Join our talent pool today to be considered for future opportunities.

jobgether-jobgether:lever:97a5e0a5-da5c-.title: Senior Ruby Developer (Ruby & Go)
jobgether-jobgether:lever:97a5e0a5-da5c-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Ruby Developer (Ruby & Go) based in France. This is a senior backend engineering opportunity focused on building and scaling secure, reliable payment infrastructure for a global fintech environment. You will take ownership of the backend powering payment portals and integrations with payment service providers. The role combines Ruby on Rails expertise with Go development for high-throughput and latency-sensitive services. You will design end-to-end deposit and withdrawal flows while ensuring robust transaction processing, reconciliation, and failure handling. Security and reliability are central, with a strong focus on financial data protection and compliance. You will also contribute to technical direction, mentor engineers, and help evolve a high-performing international engineering environment. Design, build, maintain, and own backend services using Ruby on Rails and Go, with a focus on scalability, reliability, and maintainability. Lead the integration of new payment service providers and payment methods, including cards, bank transfers, cryptocurrency, and local payment solutions. Build and maintain end-to-end deposit and withdrawal workflows, ensuring secure and consistent movement of funds across the platform. Design, implement, and consume PSP APIs, webhooks, callbacks, and other integration mechanisms. Develop transaction routing, status tracking, reconciliation, and payment lifecycle logic. Implement robust handling for payment states, retries, idempotency, failures, and edge cases to ensure resilient transaction processing. Maintain strong security controls for payment information and support compliance requirements, including PCI DSS. Monitor existing payment provider integrations, troubleshoot issues, and proactively improve reliability and performance. Develop reporting, logging, and observability capabilities that support payment operations and technical troubleshooting. Support the integration of anti-fraud, AML, and KYC controls into payment workflows. Provide technical leadership through architecture discussions, code reviews, technical decision-making, and mentorship of other engineers. Requirements 5+ years of backend engineering experience, particularly in API-driven and integration-heavy environments. Strong professional experience with Ruby and Ruby on Rails, with production-level experience in Go strongly preferred. Proven experience integrating payment service providers, payment gateways, or comparable financial APIs. Strong understanding of payment flows, webhooks, callbacks, transaction lifecycles, and payment states. Knowledge of PCI DSS and secure handling of sensitive financial and payment data. Hands-on experience with reconciliation, idempotency, retries, error handling, and other patterns required for reliable financial transactions. Experience designing, developing, and scaling distributed backend systems. Previous experience in fintech, payments, Forex, CFD brokerage, or related financial technology environments is preferred. Strong understanding of backend reliability, security, observability, and performance considerations. Excellent attention to detail, with a strong focus on building secure and dependable financial systems. Ability to communicate technical decisions clearly and contribute effectively to an international, collaborative engineering team. Benefits Fully remote position. Monday–Friday schedule, from 9:00 to 18:00. Visa sponsorship. Medical insurance starting from the first week. Career growth opportunities within a fast-scaling fintech environment. Opportunities to participate in international events, meetups, and business trips to global offices. Exposure to international payment technologies, financial products, and high-scale backend systems. How Jobgether works: We use an AI-powered matching process to ensure your application is reviewed

jobgether-jobgether:lever:e95a75e8-0d6d-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Backend Engineer (Python/Django) based in Mexico. Join a fast-growing, international technology environment where your backend expertise will directly support a global connectivity platform. You will build and scale high-performance APIs and mission-critical microservices used by millions of travelers worldwide. The role combines hands-on backend engineering with software architecture responsibilities, particularly around operations, automation, and scalability. You will help strengthen engineering quality through testing, code reviews, documentation, and modern development practices. Working closely with Product and QA teams, you will turn complex business requirements into resilient and maintainable solutions. You will also have the opportunity to tackle technical debt and performance challenges in a high-load environment. This is a fully remote role within a collaborative, international team that values continuous improvement, knowledge sharing, and autonomy. Build, maintain, and optimize mission-critical microservices using Python, Django, and Django REST Framework (DRF) . Design and develop scalable APIs capable of supporting high-concurrency traffic and significant usage peaks. Contribute to software architecture, with a particular focus on operations, automation, resilience, and scalable engineering practices. Establish and maintain strong quality frameworks through comprehensive unit testing with Pytest and automated quality checks. Identify and resolve technical debt, performance bottlenecks, inefficient database queries, N+1 problems, and asynchronous processing issues. Design and implement microservices that integrate effectively with complex third-party systems and services. Improve application performance and reliability through profiling, optimization, and appropriate asynchronous programming techniques. Work closely with Product, QA, and other engineering stakeholders across international teams to translate business requirements into maintainable technical solutions. Champion software engineering best practices across the development lifecycle, including design patterns, technical documentation, code reviews, and maintainability. Contribute to continuous improvement and automation initiatives, helping create efficient and scalable development and operational processes. Act as a technical reference for backend engineering and contribute strategic thinking while remaining hands-on with implementation. Requirements 5+ years of professional backend development experience , with strong expertise in Django and Django REST Framework. Advanced proficiency in Python , with a solid understanding of backend architecture and production software development. Proven experience designing and building microservices architectures and integrating complex third-party applications or ecosystems. Strong experience with unit testing and quality-first development practices, including Pytest or comparable testing frameworks. Practical experience with asynchronous programming and optimizing high-load database queries. Demonstrated ability to identify performance issues and improve application efficiency, scalability, and reliability. Strong understanding of API design, software architecture, design patterns, and maintainable code practices. Experience working with code reviews, technical documentation, automated quality checks, and modern software development processes. Excellent professional English skills ( C1 minimum ) for effective communication in an international, distributed environment. Strong collaboration and communication skills, with the confidence to express technical ideas clearly and contribute constructively to team decisions. Strategic mindset combined with a hands-on approach and a willingness to take ownership of technical challenges. Spanish fluency or professional working proficien

southparkcommons-vori:ashbyhq:ead9beb5-9.title: Business Development Representative
southparkcommons-vori:ashbyhq:ead9beb5-9.description: BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT REPRESENTATIVE (BDR) – PACIFIC NORTHWEST Location: Remote / Field-Based (WA / OR / ID / MT) Department: Sales – Grocery & Retail Vertical Reports To: Regional POD Lead ABOUT VORI Vori is transforming the future of the $1T grocery industry through an integrated operating system designed for independent and regional grocers. We’re a rapidly growing fintech + vertical AI startup backed by top investors, providing cutting-edge point of sale (POS), payment processing, and inventory management solutions that empower local retailers to thrive in a world dominated by retail giants like Walmart and Amazon. Our mission is simple but bold — reduce food waste, improve food access, and strengthen local communities. By connecting retailers, distributors, and brands through technology, we’re helping grocers operate smarter, faster, and more sustainably. THE ROLE We’re looking for a Business Development Representative (BDR) to help us grow our footprint across the Pacific Northwest. As a BDR at Vori, you’ll be responsible for building pipeline and opening doors for our Territory Account Executives (TAEs). You’ll prospect new grocery and specialty market accounts, research ownership groups, and connect with decision-makers to educate them on how Vori’s AI-driven platform can simplify operations and increase profitability. This role is ideal for someone hungry to break into technology sales, ready to learn full-cycle selling, and motivated by seeing their outreach turn into real, measurable impact for small businesses. WHAT YOU’LL DO - Generate new opportunities daily: Cold call, email, and use social channels to connect with independent grocery stores, markets, and distributors. - Build the top of the funnel: Identify high-potential prospects through territory research, LinkedIn, Google Maps, and local outreach. - Book qualified meetings: Schedule and coordinate introductory calls and demos between grocery operators and our Territory Account Executives. - Collaborate with your TAE: Strategize weekly on territory plans, local events, and creative outreach campaigns. - Maintain pipeline hygiene: Track activity and engagement in HubSpot CRM to ensure data accuracy and pipeline visibility. - Experiment and iterate: Share learnings and feedback with leadership and product teams to continuously improve outreach messaging and targeting. WHAT YOU BRING - 1–2 years of experience in sales, business development, or customer-facing roles (internships count). - Proven ability to cold call, build rapport, and handle objections with confidence. - Strong organizational skills and comfort managing multiple priorities. - A self-starter mentality — you’re scrappy, curious, and energized by building something new. - Excellent written and verbal communication skills. - Familiarity with HubSpot or similar CRM tools preferred. - Passion for technology, local business, or the grocery/retail ecosystem a big plus. BONUS POINTS FOR - Experience in a startup or fast-growing environment. - Previous exposure to POS, payments, SaaS, or fintech solutions. - Grocery or retail background (worked in or around the industry). WHY JOIN VORI - Competitive base + uncapped commission. - Pre-IPO equity at a Series B, venture-backed company. - Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision benefits. - Rapid growth and clear career path — top performers are promoted to Territory Account Executive roles. - A mission-driven culture focused on community, sustainability, and innovation. ACTIVE TERRITORIES We’re currently hiring BDRs to support our expansion in: - Seattle, WA - Portland, OR - Boise, ID - Missoula, MT Each territory represents a key growth market for Vori’s grocery and retail strategy.
